description: Original retro-futurist alternative score; analog electronics and 1990s garage-band textures, not artist or song imitation.

directions.synaxis.arrival.security-pulse: Cold precision clocked synth pulse, glassy sequencer ticks, low detuned analog chords; a barely audible clean guitar harmonic suggests human unease under the corporate sheen. Sparse, restrained and dialogue-safe, no drop.
directions.synaxis.offboarding.empty-floor: Bare detuned electric guitar through a small worn amplifier, hollow electric piano and low analog drone; minor suspended chords, fragile human timing, almost no percussion. Leave long pockets for dialogue; no explosive chorus.
directions.synaxis.lobby.after-hours: Polished late-century corporate ambient, elegant muted mallets, precise analog pads and distant filtered clean guitar; warm human texture buried in sterile digital rhythm. No loud hooks.
directions.synaxis.basement.server-room: Minimal industrial sequencer, transformer-like low bass and brittle metallic percussion; muted guitar string noise and unstable minor chords, sparse repetitive tension without a climax.
directions.synaxis.departure.street: Bittersweet clean guitar arpeggio over warm analog bass; gradual addition of slightly overdriven rhythm guitar and loose live kit, understated transition from defeat to independence, natural ending.
directions.morrow.title.theme: Original short angular melodic cell shared by analog lead and raw electric guitar; vulnerable clean verse texture expanding into a wide fuzzy power-chord refrain, warm synth bass and imperfect acoustic kit. Memorable, melancholy, defiant, no borrowed motifs.
directions.central-exchange.day: Glossy analog synth and restrained drum machine against lightly overdriven guitar and a human bass performance; syncopated city momentum, bittersweet modal color, modest dynamics for exploration.
directions.brickwater.night: Rain-soaked dub delays, deep analog chord stabs and tremolo electric guitar, scuffed tape texture, loose half-time kit and slow fuzz swells; weary nocturnal groove with room for city ambience.
directions.vesper.market: Warm plucked analog synth, syncopated live bass, dry guitar chops and drum machine with loose acoustic fills; lively neighborhood warmth, unobtrusive original hook.
directions.horizon.commons: Unamplified-feeling clean electric guitar, felt piano, warm synth haze, gentle imperfect phrasing and distant brushed drums; quiet hope, no heavy chorus.
directions.north-quay.harbor: Slow distorted bass, sparse clean guitar with long reverb and wide cold analog pads; distant metallic percussion and soft toms, melancholy working waterfront atmosphere.
directions.southworks.industrial: Mechanical sequenced rhythm interlocked with a raw acoustic kit, down-tuned fuzzy guitar and distorted bass, sparse metallic synth; working-class industrial groove without masking machinery.
directions.m-line.transit: Steady train-like drum machine with loose acoustic accents, repeating clean guitar figure and warm filtered analog arpeggios; rhythmic motion, restrained dynamics and smooth development.
directions.courier.delivery: Tight electronic breakbeat, live bass, short original fuzz guitar accents and lean analog arpeggios; propulsive forward motion without a constant wall of sound.
directions.pursuit.alert: Tense analog pulse with muted low guitar, tight drum machine and anxious bass, minimal unstable harmony. Controlled escalation and room for dispatch and engine audio.
directions.pursuit.escape: Urgent breakbeat interlocking with live kit, aggressive distorted bass and short angular fuzz guitar riff; urgent analog ostinato, bounded density and room for police and vehicles.
directions.pursuit.cooldown: Descending detuned synth notes and exposed clean guitar, sparse half-time acoustic percussion, residual amplifier texture, gradual decompression.
directions.brickwater.arcade.attract-loop: Original retro FM chip lead with a compact angular guitar-like synth hook, punchy electronic drums and even dynamics; short loop-friendly instrumental without literal guitar feedback.
directions.brickwater.arcade.racing: Original fast 16-bit-inspired FM lead and crunchy guitar-like chip bass, crisp drums and a distinctive repeating hook; loop-friendly ending.
directions.afterhours.club.original-break: Underground garage band instrumental: quiet clean guitar verses break into abrasive fuzzy power-chord choruses, loose acoustic drums, distorted bass and small detuned synth counterline. Raw live-room performance, original riff and human imperfections.
directions.vesper.club.floor: Warehouse techno with a firm four-on-the-floor kick, rolling analog bass, acid-like synth and chopped original feedback textures as restrained percussion; continuous dance groove without rock chorus.
directions.lantern.cup.lounge: Warm Rhodes, understated clean electric guitar, upright-like bass and brushed kit with softly worn tape character; intimate original future jazz, low conversational density.
directions.morrow.home.safe: Quiet clean guitar fingerpicking, soft detuned analog pad and tape-worn electric piano; very sparse percussion and human timing, intimate private refuge.
directions.morrow.credits: Original bittersweet clean guitar and analog pad motif, expanding into restrained fuzzy power chords and loose live drums before resolving back to intimate guitar; reflective and quietly defiant, natural ending.
